title: SAP NetWeaver (Internet Graphics Service) does not sufficiently validate certain input values within… (CVE-2026-109806)
description: SAP NetWeaver Internet Graphics Service contains a vulnerability where it does not sufficiently validate certain input values in incoming requests. An unauthenticated attacker can send a specially crafted request with malformed image data that triggers an integer overflow, causing repeated termination of the worker process. This results in a denial of service condition impacting availability without affecting confidentiality or integrity.
